launches.title: Zidisha - Crowdfunding for developing country entrepreneurs
launches.tagline: We let you crowdfund and interact directly with remarkable entrepreneurs in developing countries.
launches.body:
TL;DR: Fund a small business for a low-income entrepreneur in Africa or Asia. Interact directly with your chosen entrepreneur via chat, photos and videos. Then watch your impact multiply as the entrepreneur pays your donation forward by funding other entrepreneurs in need.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71010&key=user_uploads/36608/a2a1c289-4c12-44b5-9559-68e075dd0a1d)

### The problem: Developing country businesses lack capital

Small businesses provide 80% of employment in Africa and other emerging markets - but they lack access to the capital they need to grow and provide more jobs. Too small to be profitable for banks and too large to benefit from consumer loan apps, these businesses are called the “missing middle” because they fall between the tiers served by existing financial infrastructure.

For example, Daniel started a cybercafe in a low-income neighborhood in Ghana. His facility is the only source of internet access in the community, but it has only two computers and people must wait for hours to use them. Daniel earns barely enough to support his family, and there isn’t enough left over to invest in new machines.

### The solution: Connecting entrepreneurs to investment capital

A friend invites Daniel to use Zidisha, and he signs up and posts his story and photos on the platform. His initial project of $50 is funded by a combination of Zidisha entrepreneurs and philanthropic backers who visit the website. He uses the $50 to buy a printer and add printing services to his cybercafe. Within a couple of months, the printer has paid for itself. Daniel “pays it forward” by funding $50 worth of projects for other fundraising entrepreneurs on the platform.

In a subsequent project, Daniel raises $300 and uses it to acquire two more second-hand computers. This doubles the capacity of his cybercafe and Daniel’s earnings. Daniel pays the $300 forward to other Zidisha entrepreneurs while continuing to benefit from the increased cash flow. The increased earnings allow Daniel to enroll his daughter in high school.

Eventually, Daniel raises $1000 to open a second cybercafe in a nearby neighborhood. He hires two employees to help him manage the second cybercafe.

### How it works

Entrepreneurs in developing countries create project pages where they share their story, photos, and descriptions of their investment opportunity. Projects are funded by backers from all over the world.

Instead of repaying the projects as loans, entrepreneurs “pay it forward” by in turn funding other entrepreneurs on the platform.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71010&key=user_uploads/36608/bd8803ee-5359-4009-8d63-e66a4c4fe466)

Entrepreneurs post project updates and interact directly with their backers through the project discussion tab.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=71010&key=user_uploads/36608/e1786735-029d-492b-b38c-6cafcec477d9)

Backers can view which projects were funded by their entrepreneurs and watch their impact grow over time as the funds continue to be recycled.

### How you can help

* Connect us with impact investors who are interested in creating new opportunities in developing countries. Email the founder, Julia Kurnia, at julia (at) zidisha.org.
* [Visit our website](https://www.zidisha.org) to meet an entrepreneur today!

A user can follow other users and have other users following them thus creating a vibrant community. Users can have people liking and commenting on their post, increasing engagement and creating a vibrant hair community.

launches.title: Indy: AI support tool for ADHD
launches.tagline: AI support system that helps with ADHD, not just your to-do list
launches.body:
tl;dr: _After supporting adults with ADHD across 80,000+ coaching sessions, we kept seeing the same gap: people gain clarity about what matters, but struggle to hold onto it in everyday life. Indy is a free, AI-powered ADHD support app designed to help people stay oriented to what matters and translate that clarity into daily action, without relying on productivity pressure or generic AI advice._

_—_

Hi YC family! 👋

We’re Chris & Vikram, and we’re building Shimmer. Our mission is for every individual with ADHD to reach their full potential, their way. Shimmer began after I (Chris) was diagnosed with ADHD and struggled to access affordable, high-quality behavioral support. Since then, we’ve grown into the #1 ADHD coaching platform recommended by clinicians across North America.

As large language models became viable, we saw a clear opportunity. ADHD isn’t a problem of knowledge, it’s a problem of continuity. Insight is available, but support disappears between moments. AI, for the first time, makes it possible to provide consistent, personalized scaffolding in the flow of daily life.

That opportunity is what led us to build Indy.

### **❌ The Challenge**

Across tens of thousands of ADHD coaching sessions, one pattern shows up again and again.

Breakthroughs don’t fail because people forget what they learned. They fail because daily life takes over.

People leave a session with clarity about what matters and where they want to go. Then the week happens. Context shifts. Energy fluctuates. Emotions spike. Urgency crowds out direction.

For ADHDers, this breakdown is predictable:

1. **🧠 Executive function is state-dependent**: What feels obvious in one moment is inaccessible in another. Memory, motivation, and prioritization fluctuate with energy and emotion.
2. **🕳 The future fades quickly**: When goals are not emotionally present, the present always wins. ADHD brains respond to what feels salient now.
3. **⏳ Support is episodic and constrained by human capacity**: Coaching, therapy, etc. work primarily during sessions, but disappear when real decisions are being made.

Existing tools don’t address this well. General AI gives answers. Productivity apps manage tasks. Neither maintains orientation or adapts as conditions change.

### **✨ The AI Opportunity**

AI changes what’s possible here.

For the first time, software can:

* Hold personal context over time
* Reflect patterns back to users
* Adapt support based on energy, emotion, and behavior
* Provide lightweight scaffolding between human interactions

This is especially powerful for ADHD, where the problem isn’t knowing what to do, but staying connected to why and when to do it.

### **✨ The Solution**

Indy is a daily AI-powered ADHD support system designed to help people stay oriented to what matters and translate that clarity into everyday action.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96820&key=user_uploads/608519/4f19593d-f653-4231-9af2-dec8ee54418c)

Here’s how it works:

1. **Future mapping**: Users map key moments from their past, present, and future to anchor what they care about and where they’re headed.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96820&key=user_uploads/608519/ca3c694c-2405-4ab4-a880-4248696f0539)

2. **Daily and weekly check-ins**: Indy helps users set lightweight intentions, anticipate obstacles, and reflect without pressure.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96820&key=user_uploads/608519/01183d22-d2fc-4650-a66e-74ae3a1d3886)

3. **Insights over time**: Indy turns check-ins into pattern visibility. Users start to see what drains them, what helps, where momentum shows up, and what keeps derailing progress, so they can adjust earlier.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96820&key=user_uploads/608519/00ed985f-2290-48c7-9c15-9ae24d10e742)

4. **Problem-solving when stuck**: When friction shows up, Indy uses science-backed frameworks to help users identify what’s actually blocking progress and choose a small next step.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96820&key=user_uploads/608519/9faff07a-2505-4abb-9067-17aee2dbc862)

5. **Progress made visible**: Wins, effort, and insights are tracked so progress doesn’t disappear just because it wasn’t perfect.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96820&key=user_uploads/608519/7bbaa3f4-f6a9-4c49-9161-cdd848e8de8a)


AI gives us a chance to rethink how behavioral support works for ADHD. Indy is our first step toward making that support continuous, accessible, and humane. Check out Indy to see it in practice! And [here](https://www.shimmer.care/blog/indy-app-for-adhd-wellbeing) is the full blog post!

This isn’t another chatbot or copilot, it’s a suite of embedded AI tools that amplifies the human connection between member & coach—helping members get more out of sessions and between sessions._

---

Hi YC family! 👋

We’re Chris & Vikram, and we’re building [Shimmer](http://www.shimmer.care). Our mission is for every individual with ADHD to reach their full potential, _their way_. Shimmer ADHD Coaching was born in 2022 after I (Chris) was diagnosed with ADHD and was frustrated with the lack of affordable, quality behavioral coaching solutions. Since then, we’ve grown tremendously, building the #1 ADHD Coaching Platform recommended by HCPs, therapists, and psychiatrists across North America.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kHXzu0JYVtg&t=1s>

### **❌ The Challenge**

At Shimmer, we’ve run over 45,000 ADHD coaching sessions. Each session is packed with “aha” moments—but as soon as they’re over, life pulls you in a million directions and those insights slip away. To add to this, the week is often lost from lack of accountability and members come into sessions scrambling to remember the past week. Overall, for people with ADHD, it’s hard to _consistently_ hold onto what you learn, recognize bigger patterns, or stay on track day to day. Why?

1. 🚧 **Our working memory challenges makes it hard to remember sessions**. Even the best breakthroughs vanish without a simple way to capture and revisit them.
2. 👹 **We’re focused on the present & don’t always see the bigger picture (or future)**. Without a clear record, it’s tough to connect recurring themes or measure real progress.
3. 🍬 **We lose momentum between sessions**. A coach can’t be there 24/7—and ADHD brains need constant nudges to stay motivated.

### **✨ The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87083&key=user_uploads/608519/53f337be-252d-4135-9f36-9b78d22d1d5b)

**Shimmer 2.0** is our new AI-powered “second brain,” doing what ADHD brains were never designed to do. Shimmer 2.0 automatically captures and organizes all your coaching insights, so you can finally spot the patterns, stay accountable, and turn each breakthrough into real-world action—even when your coach isn’t around. Here’s a bit on how it works:

1. **AI-Powered Session Summaries:** Shimmer 2.0’s AI automatically recaps each session’s main points and action items, so you can easily revisit breakthroughs without piecing together scattered notes.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87083&key=user_uploads/608519/57f4600f-1280-4249-842b-1ee892aaa488)

2. **Action Insights & Progress Tracking:** Visually map out your weekly actions, highlight patterns, and keep yourself accountable.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87083&key=user_uploads/608519/367d604b-cd7d-465d-ae02-9fef4addd3fa)

3. **History (Second Brain):** View your entire journey in one place & instantly look up specific topics from past sessions and spot recurring themes at a glance.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87083&key=user_uploads/608519/ac9d5072-a251-4a37-8c1e-ae4dc05890ae)

4. **Smart Search:** Lastly, my personal favorite—Ask your “second brain” the hard questions, like: “What strategies have worked for me?”, “What did my coach say about procrastination?”, “What should I be proud of”?

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87083&key=user_uploads/608519/af1c2807-67a0-4141-922f-e2dc168185fa)


Check out how Shimmer 2.0 weaves **AI** into your everyday coaching experience, amplifying the power of expert human coaching.

tl;dr: _After facilitating over 31,000 1:1 ADHD Coaching sessions, Shimmer members have access to the first multi-player community feature on the Platform—Body Doubling! Shimmer’s Body Doubling experience takes the popular ADHD co-working strategy and infuses the 6 ADHD motivators to help our members get more things done, the ADHD way._

---

Hi YC family! 👋

We’re Chris & Vikram, and we’re building [**Shimmer**](http://www.shimmer.care/). Our mission is for every individual with ADHD to reach their full potential, _their way_. Shimmer ADHD Coaching was born in 2022 after I (Chris) was diagnosed with ADHD and was frustrated with the lack of affordable, quality behavioral coaching solutions. Since then, we’ve grown tremendously, building the #1 ADHD Coaching Platform recommended by HCPs, therapists, and psychiatrists across North America.

### **❌ The Challenge**

Body doubling is a popular strategy for people with ADHD (it works for neurotypical people too!) to get things done. It’s basically when you work in the presence of others, and the mere existence of them gives you positive accountability to get it done. It comes in many forms, and can even look like you doing laundry while chatting with your boyfriend while he cooks.

The challenge for people with ADHD, is that they don’t do these things consistently. Why?

1. 🚧 **There’s too many hurdles**. They need to coordinate with people, it’s inconsistent, and people are unreliable
2. 👹 **They’re ashamed**. Many body doubling apps exist already, but people with ADHD feel ashamed needing this tool just for their laundry, or to cook, or to do something else that seems mundane. Imagine showing up to a session and you can barely brush your teeth, and the other person says “I’m going to finish emailing back 10 investors on closing my round and launch our new podcast to Spotify”
3. 🍬 **There’s not enough dopamine**. Isn’t this always the challenge with ADHD?! Whatever solution is out there, it’s not built to motivate ADHD brains.

### **✨ The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83793&key=user_uploads/608519/dd6ff9c4-77bc-4531-9e74-ef8e34bf9129)

Shimmer Body Doubling (only available to Shimmer coaching members) is an ADHD-adapted Body Doubling experience that harnesses the power of the 6 ADHD motivators—interest, urgency, newness, accountability, challenge, and community, to help people with ADHD get things done.

1. Before kicking off ADHD Body Doubling sessions, check-in with your feelings & connect with those of others.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83793&key=user_uploads/608519/ba3ef126-616c-448d-817e-a8b7359131a1)

2. Commit to discrete tasks to stay accountable and get dopamine from checking things off!

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83793&key=user_uploads/608519/8dd2a99e-920e-47bc-adeb-71c8a80adc5a)

3. Get inspired by other people’s tasks and progress. Motivation is contagious!

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83793&key=user_uploads/608519/b3e57121-c5dc-46d8-9759-2ec7f5a59743)

4. Visualize time passing (key for ADHD brains!) and beat the clock

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83793&key=user_uploads/608519/d5776eb8-0d96-44cc-bc73-d74d8c75ebce)

5. Learn something new in the 5 min break as each ADHD Coach brings their own flare

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83793&key=user_uploads/608519/879d8e04-3b90-4cfe-bc46-2c17eed45d0f)

6. If you have a challenge or problem, your community and an expert ADHD coach will be there to help you out!

launches.body:
# **Problem**

**Most people struggle alone for years**

And it makes it nearly impossible to see improvement. The person might turn to friends and family, but they overreact or aren’t able to effectively support because they can’t relate. On top of that, professional help or in-person groups can be expensive, and it takes a lot of courage to get there.

**Even those attending in-person groups (e.g. AA) feel isolated between weekly meetings**

For the minority who do join a group-based program, meetings are usually held only once a week — leaving participants largely on their own the other six days of the week.

# **Solution**

Relay helps users…

* Get matched into a team of 5-8 peers
* Experience meaningful connection and avoid slipping back into isolation
* Find shame-free accountability
* Train emotional awareness and understand patterns/triggers
* Throw a red flag (i.e. SOS) with a single tap to let their team know they need help when feeling vulnerable

Since launching in September 2021, 79% of our users have reported seeing improvement within their first month of using the app.

## **Why we’re tackling this**

Members on our team have struggled personally with addiction and saw first-hand the power that comes from forming an effective team of peers for connection and accountability. We’ve also had many friends and loved ones who have dealt with these challenges, and so it’s a problem we’re deeply passionate about solving.

### **TL;DR**

Trata gives hedge funds un-biased, unfiltered stock analysis from anonymous Analysts at well-known funds. Our AI agents interview Analysts at multi-billion dollar funds, capture their thinking about the stocks they know and publish it anonymously.

### **Problem:**

1. It takes buyside Analysts at least 3 hours to figure out a company’s key narratives/points of debate - what outcomes are going to drive the share price up OR down? Examples: an ongoing lawsuit, a competitor going bankrupt, an Activist campaign, a new CEO, etc. This involves reading earnings call transcripts, initiation reports, talking to Investor Relations, reaching out to other Analysts, and piecing everything together yourself.
2. Because of the time it takes to do step 1, would-be winners/inflection points fall through the cracks all the time.
3. Current solutions (idea dinners, forums like Value Investors Club, Twitter DMs, independent research boutiques and even paid Substacks) are fragmented and biased.
4. The highest quality leads come from talking directly to fellow Analysts, but there’s never been a way to do this at scale, authentically. Until now.

### **Solution:**

We use LLMs to interview dozens of people a day, get their quick and honest takes on signals/points of debate they’re actually paying attention to, and turn that into a one-of-a-kind research product. Each conversation is with an anonymous hedge fund Analyst who is deeply familiar with the company – think an expert network where the hedge funds are the experts. Contributors share their knowledge to gain access to an exponentially bigger pool of expertise.

We don’t provide investment advice; we just get you up to speed – fast. We work directly with the compliance teams of multi-billion dollar hedge funds and have a team of human lawyers to ensure SEC compliance.

We are building the product I wish I had as an Analyst. Our first user interviews liked the idea so much (without any code built) that they are now our angels.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gE_Ovy1BiTM>

### **Here’s how to think about our value proposition:**

If a fund manages $300 million, one successful idea (3% position, +50% return) generates $4.5 million in profit and $900K in fees ($720/180K split between the Portfolio Manager and Analyst). This is a 750X, 120X, and 30X ROI on a $6K subscription for the Fund, Portfolio Manager and Analyst.

All it takes is one decent idea for Trata to be a home run.

If you are a hedge fund Analyst or know any hedge fund Analysts / public investors, please reach out! They don't have to be at a big fund like Citadel for us to be interested. We pay very well. They will most likely thank you for the intro. We guarantee anonymity. Contact us at [founders@trytrata.com](mailto:founders@trytrata.com).

Bubble Lab helps event organizers and professional communities turn a room full of people into meaningful connections. We help them understand who’s in the room, identify who should meet, make the introduction, and remember those relationships for the next event.

Attendee enrichment, matchmaking, searchable member directories, applications, payments, Luma and Slack sync, onboarding, and analytics all live in one place, so a single operator can run better gatherings and build a smarter community over time.
one_liner: Turn gatherings into lasting relationships.

launches.title: Bubble Lab - Supercharge your Ops work in Slack
launches.tagline: Meet Pearl, your super-employee that handles your ops tasks in slack
launches.body:
Hey everyone! 👋

We’re [Selina](https://www.linkedin.com/in/selina-li-2624a4198/) and [Zach](https://www.linkedin.com/in/zzy0516/) from Bubble Lab. 

**TL;DR:** Bubble Lab lets you deploy Pearl, your ops super-employee, directly into Slack. Pearl connects to tools like Notion, Jira, and Stripe and runs real operational workflows for your team—no engineering required.

**THE PROBLEM** ❌

Operations work today is fragmented across dozens of tools. Updating CRMs after calls, generating reports, triaging customer issues, and coordinating workflows all require constant context switching and manual effort.

Automating these processes is even harder. Existing tools are brittle, require engineering time, or live outside where teams actually work. As a result, most ops teams still rely on manual processes, even for repetitive, predictable tasks.

This slows teams down and makes it harder to scale operations without scaling headcount.

**OUR SOLUTION** 👷

Demo: <https://youtu.be/BIvOZCGgRSA>

Bubble Lab lets you deploy Pearl, your ops super-employee, directly into Slack in under a minute.

We’re already powering 4,000+ operators and fast-moving teams.

Pearl connects securely to your tools— Notion, Jira, HubSpot, Stripe, Google Workspace, and more—and can take action on your behalf. Teams use Pearl to:

* Update HubSpot automatically after sales calls
* Create Jira tickets from user feedback
* Generate daily pipeline and revenue reports
* Track and follow up on open invoices
* Run operational workflows triggered directly from Slack

When something needs to be repeated, Pearl turns it into a reliable workflow your team can run anytime.

Instead of switching between tools or building custom automation infrastructure, teams can run and manage operations entirely from Slack.

 **OUR ASK 🙏**

If you run ops or growth at your company, we’d love to hear from you.

Try Bubble Lab:[ https://bubblelab.ai](https://bubblelab.ai)

We’re especially excited to work with teams that want to automate operational workflows across their stack without engineering overhead.
